backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor defining NFT collections, items, and user profiles with CRUD operations; enforces admin/user access control via MixinAuthorization and uses MixinStorage for blob handling.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the requirement to update NFTCollectionsSection.tsx with seven specific Getgems-linked NFT collections, each with a dedicated preview image and external URL.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short summaries describing each component, page, hook, and config file's purpose in the application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Istvan Seidel light art portfolio app, setting German language, viewport meta, title, description, and mounting the React root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (gallery, artwork, upload, contact, blog, NFT gallery/detail, admin) wrapped in a dark-mode ThemeProvider and Layout.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Admin form component for creating or editing NFT collections, using useCreateCollection and useUpdateCollection hooks with German-language labels and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Admin list component displaying all NFT collections with edit and delete actions, using an AlertDialog for delete confirmation and skeleton loading states.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: A form component for creating and editing NFTs, supporting image upload with progress tracking, collection selection, price input, and integration with create/update NFT hooks.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Displays a list of all NFTs in the admin panel with thumbnail, collection name, price badge, and options to edit or delete each NFT with confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: A card component that displays a single legacy artwork with its image, title, and description, featuring hover scale and overlay animations.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper providing a sticky header with logo, navigation, and login button, a main content area, and a footer with copyright and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: A button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing loading state and triggering query cache invalidation on logout.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top navigation bar component that renders route-aware buttons for main pages, conditionally showing Upload and Admin links based on authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A small badge component displaying an 'NFT' label with a sparkles icon, used to mark NFT items.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: A card component linking to an NFT detail page, displaying the NFT image, title, collection name, token ID, price, and on-chain minted status.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: A card component for an NFT collection that links to an external marketplace URL, showing a collection image with loading/error states, title, description, and a trade call-to-action.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: A section component that renders a static grid of Istvan Seidel's NFT collections on the TON blockchain, each linking to their respective Getgems marketplace pages.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: A React section component that explains NFT technology (what NFTs are, automatic minting, and ICP architecture) using styled cards with icons, rendered in German.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: Displays metadata for a single NFT item (token ID, mint date, price, and ICP Explorer link) with formatted helpers for dates and prices.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Defines a StaticBlogPost interface and exports an array of static German-language blog posts about light health, blue light, and red light therapy with hardcoded content and timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls the backend actor's addCollection method and invalidates the nft-collections query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that mints a new NFT via the backend actor, fetches the created item, and invalidates the nft-items query, with user-friendly auth error parsing.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes a collection by ID via the actor and invalidates both nft-collections and nft-items queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT by ID via the actor and invalidates the nft-items query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old artwork backend which has been superseded by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Stub query hook that always returns an empty array for backend blog posts, deferring to static blog posts instead.
Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor, enabled only when the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches all NFT items from the backend actor, enabled only when the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns null, replacing the old single-artwork fetch from the deprecated artwork backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old category-filtered artwork fetch from the deprecated backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Stub query hook that always returns null for a single blog post, deferring to static posts instead.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's user profile from the backend actor, with combined loading state from both actor and query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: Query hook that fetches a single NFT item by ID from the backend actor, enabled only when actor and ID are available.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: Query hook that fetches all NFT items belonging to a specific collection ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks whether the currently authenticated caller is an admin by calling the backend actor's `isCallerAdmin` method.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile via the backend actor and invalidates the `currentUserProfile` query on success.
Stub mutation hook for the contact form that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT collection's name and description via the backend actor and invalidates the `nft-collections` query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT item's metadata and image via the backend actor and invalidates the `nft-items` query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook for artwork upload that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Hook that handles image file uploads to the backend actor with progress tracking, format validation, and auth error parsing.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a warm art-themed light and dark color palette, plus Google Fonts imports.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin-only dashboard page with tabs for managing NFT collections and NFT items, including forms and lists for creating and editing each, with auth guard redirects.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Placeholder artwork detail page that displays a 'not found' message, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Blog listing page that merges static and backend blog posts, displays them as clickable cards, and shows a 'New Post' button for admins.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Admin-only page for creating new blog posts with title, content, and optional featured image upload, redirecting non-admins to the blog listing.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Displays a single blog post by ID, merging static local posts with backend data, showing title, publication date, featured image, and content.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact form page with name, email, subject, and message fields that submits via a mutation hook and shows success or error alerts.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Gallery landing page showing a hero banner, a random Walter Russell quote, NFT collections section, and an NFT explanation section.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single NFT showing its image, title, description, collection badge, price, on-chain metadata, and a link to the ICP dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: NFT gallery page listing all NFTs with collection filter buttons, skeleton loading states, and an upload button for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: React page component for uploading and minting NFTs, allowing authenticated users to fill in metadata, select a collection, upload an image with progress tracking, and view the minted result.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions for merging static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, finding a post by ID, and formatting timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and removing sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom fonts (Inter, Playfair Display), an oklch-based color system, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations including accordion and fade-in effects.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the Istvan Seidel Werkverzeichnis site, its seven TON Blockchain NFT collections with Getgems URLs, required preview images, existing features, and pending feature requests.
